items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, they came over together with a son, Liaquat.

ctx.x: Annie Ross of Lambert, Hendricks and Ross?

Yeah, they came over together with a son, Liaquat. They broke up sort of, and Kenny wanted to go back to Paris and left Annie here with the son, and she took him to Kenny’s sister in Pittsburgh. And Carmen McRae was Kenny Clarke’s ex-wife, too. And Carmen helped raise the son along with the sisters. It was kind of complicated as far as his personal life at that time.
Connie, the reason I talk about him, he was kind of the final link to the MJQ that we know that has lasted so long…
